# v3 phase 4: Emirate events (generated by tools/build_emirate.py)
add_namespace = nsr_emirate

country_event = {
	id = nsr_emirate.3
	title = nsr_emirate.3.t
	desc = nsr_emirate.3.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_conference
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.3.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_shura_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_shura_bop value = -0.15 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_tamkin }
		}
		add_stability = 0.03
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.3.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_shura_bop } }
			add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_shura_bop value = 0.15 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_jihad }
		}
		add_war_support = 0.03
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.3.c
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_political_power = 50
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr_emirate.6
	title = nsr_emirate.6.t
	desc = nsr_emirate.6.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.6.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hold_all_p5
		hidden_effect = {
			every_owned_state = {
				set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 5 }
				NSR_state_hold_change = yes
			}
		}
		add_stability = -0.05
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_lions_world
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_government = democratic
					is_major = yes
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_lions_removed }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_lions_removed
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.6.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_stability = 0.05
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_lions_kept
		hidden_effect = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } }
				set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 5 }
				NSR_state_hold_change = yes
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_lions_kept
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr_emirate.17
	title = nsr_emirate.17.t
	desc = nsr_emirate.17.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty2
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.17.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = nsr_emirate.16 days = 5 } }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = NSR_hajj_agreement }
		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = NSR_hajj_agreement }
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr_emirate.17.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 3 }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = nsr_emirate.18 days = 3 } }
		reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = NSR_hajj_refused }
	}
}
